name: Fragmented Memory
description: Memory instability disrupts the body's trained responses. Each round costs focus.

name: Weakened
description: Something in the strike destabilized your footing and your form.

name: Shattered Perception
description: Reality flickers at the edges of your vision. Reliable action becomes unreliable.

name: Bleeding
description: A wound that does not close cleanly in this environment.

name: Reinforced
description: A moment of clarity hardens your defenses.

name: Focused
description: The fractures quiet briefly. Your mind becomes clear.
